verdict.rationale: AgentMail exposes a hosted MCP server with inbox/message/thread/draft/attachment tools plus REST API, webhooks, and human-in-the-loop cc/bcc, giving external agents like Claude a documented path to read, triage, draft, and send email end to end. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that Claude/ChatGPT specifically completes a full triage-to-send workflow via this connection.
